title: ACFO: Geometry factorization and representation dispatch for repeated curved Fourier inference
description: ACFO provides prepared forward-adjoint operators and representation dispatch for repeated curved Fourier inference. Version 0.2.0 includes the manuscript-facing source code, figure source data, normalized external-validation evidence and executable numerical audits for WAXS, ODT and NuMagSANS applications. High-NA Debye-Wolf material is included only as Supplementary accuracy-control evidence.
